# Giannis Antetokounmpo TRADED To Miami Heat In NBA Blockbuster! Game Over For The League?

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-06-23, 20:03. https://youtu.be/nnWX_ObljOE

## Summary

Josh Lloyd reacts to Giannis Antetokounmpo being traded to Miami. Bobby Portis goes to Miami with him. Milwaukee gets Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel'el Ware, Kasparas Jakucionis, three first-round picks (including pick 13), a pick swap and a second-round pick. He thinks Milwaukee's return is not disastrous, but their rotation is now very crowded. Herro's value should stay similar, Ware's probably goes up, and more moves or a rebuild may follow. In Miami, he expects Giannis's minutes and assist rate to rise because the team lacks ball handlers, so his fantasy value probably goes up. Bam Adebayo, Andrew Wiggins and especially Norman Powell should take usage hits, and Miami's depth is now poor.
